pages.title: Recorded project showcase
pages.description: See how a recorded Beam session appears inside the Video Editor.
pages.lead: A recorded session opens as a complete composition with its captured media arranged for editing.

sections.title: A project ready to edit
paragraphs: The canvas presents the composed output while the timeline keeps recorded media and editing layers visible for timing, framing, captions, audio, and export adjustments.

screenshot.alt: Beam editor showing a recorded project with its canvas and timeline
screenshot.caption: A recorded project ready for timing, framing, captions, audio, and export adjustments.
